grading: (1) Responds with a single clarifying question listing the plausible companies, for example United Airlines Holdings (UAL), United Parcel Service (UPS), UnitedHealth Group (UNH), United Rentals (URI). answer: Asks which 'United' (UAL, UPS, UNH, URI) and gives no figures.

output.answer:
"United" could refer to a couple of companies. Here are the Q2 2026 revenue figures for both:

**United Airlines (UAL)** — Q2 2026 (quarter ended June 30)
- **Total operating revenue: $17.67 billion**, up ~16% year over year (roughly in line with the ~$17.68B consensus)
- Passenger revenue: $16.10B (+16.4%); domestic +20.3%, international +11.2%
- Adjusted EPS: $1.99 (beat estimates)
- Sources: [Yahoo Finance/Zacks](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/united-ual-6-4-since-153005284.html), [Yahoo Finance earnings recap](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/united-airlines-q2-2026-earnings-203046842.html)

**UnitedHealth Group (UNH)** — Q2 2026 (quarter ended June 2026)
- **Revenue: $112.03 billion**, beating the ~$110.1B consensus by ~1.7%
- Adjusted EPS: $6.38; raised full-year adjusted EPS outlook to $19.50–$20
- Sources: [Yahoo Finance/Zacks](https://finance.yahoo.com/healthcare/articles/unitedhealth-group-unh-q2-earnings-110502398.html), [WSJ](https://www.wsj.com/business/earnings/unitedhealth-results-handily-beat-wall-street-expectations-fb967ef6)

Let me know which company you meant if you'd like more detail.
